steps.title: Browser credentials
steps.description: Harvested browser passwords and passkeys, masked by default. Tap to reveal — biometric re-prompt if you enabled it.

steps.title: Keystroke capture
steps.description: Live keylogger tail per app; password-context entries are highlighted and can be promoted into the credentials table.

steps.title: Wallets
steps.description: Seed phrases require double-tap + biometric. Balance lookups stay off until you enable them per wallet.
